text: 中国人民银行发布2026年人民币国际化报告提出，下一步，中国人民银行将推进人民币国际化。顺应市场需求，进一步完善人民币跨境使用基础性制度安排，更好满足各类主体人民币交易结算、投融资、风险管理等需求。深化金融市场开放，支持上海国际金融中心建设。支持人民币离岸市场发展，巩固提升香港国际金融中心地位。健全金融基础设施，统筹好金融开放和金融安全。
text_en: The People's Bank of China released the 2026 RMB Internationalization Report, proposing that in the next step, the People's Bank of China will advance RMB internationalization. In line with market demand, it will further improve the foundational institutional arrangements for cross-border RMB use and better meet the needs of various entities for RMB trade settlement, investment and financing, and risk management. It will deepen the opening up of the financial market and support the construction of Shanghai as an international financial center. It will support the development of the offshore RMB market and consolidate and enhance Hong Kong's status as an international financial center. It will improve financial infrastructure and coordinate financial opening up and financial security.
